name: HHMI Hanna H. Gray Fellows Program
amount: Salary or stipend by postdoc experience plus support for fellowship expenses
other_rules: Authorized to work in the US for the appointment
no more than 7 years of postdoc experience by 15 Dec 2026
in a mentored postdoc at an HHMI-eligible US institution
must intend to start a tenure-track faculty post at an eligible institution by 1 May 2030
aimed at people from groups underrepresented in science
notes: Biennial competition, now combined with the Freeman Hrabowski Scholars Program. 2028 competition opens 3 Nov 2026 and closes 15 Dec 2026; appointments start May-Aug 2028. Fellows who land a faculty job become Hrabowski Scholars.
